title: What If a Nuclear Bomb Exploded in Space? In 1962 One Did

scenes.text: What if a nuclear bomb went off in space? The damage lands on Earth.
In 1962 the US did it for real. A 1.4 megaton warhead went off 400 kilometers above the Pacific.
Vacuum carries no blast wave. But the burst threw out radiation that Earth's magnetic field trapped.
Far away in Hawaii, a power surge blew out hundreds of streetlights, and phone service dropped.
The sky glowed with an artificial aurora across thousands of kilometers, and trapped electrons lingered for months.
Several satellites in orbit failed, including Telstar, launched the next day. The explosion that hurt no one on the ground still crippled space.
